description: This file defines the OrangeHrmClient class, a minimal HTTP client wrapper for interfacing with the OrangeHRM API for automation testing purposes. It supports cookie-based login, bearer token authentication, mock/demo mode responses, and provides utility methods for API path construction and JSON parsing. It also contains a nested DemoBackend class for simulating API responses in demo mode.

classes.name: OrangeHrmClient
classes.description: A sealed class providing HTTP interactions with the OrangeHRM API, including login, authenticated and anonymous requests, and utility functions.

methods.name: LoginWithCookiesAsync
methods.description: Attempts to log in using the web auth endpoint with username and password.

methods.name: ExecuteAuthedAsync
methods.description: Executes an authenticated API request, adding headers and handling mock mode.

methods.name: ExecuteAnonAsync
methods.description: Executes an anonymous API request, adding headers and handling mock mode.

methods.name: V2
methods.description: Constructs a full API v2 resource URL from a relative path.

methods.name: ParseJson
methods.description: Parses JSON content into a JsonDocument, throwing if input is empty.
